tolls.name: Túnel d'Envalira
tolls.notes: Single toll tunnel Grau Roig <-> Pas de la Casa on CG-2; only tolled road in Andorra. 2026 light-vehicle (Tipus 1) tariff EUR 8.10 (was 7.90, +2.5%). A 50% discount exists for Pas de la Casa residents/workers and Andorran transport firms - NOT applied (default = non-resident). Coordinate approx = west (Grau Roig) portal / toll plaza; refine from OSM barrier=toll_booth.
